description: Fetches `url`. If the server returns HTTP 402, signs an EIP-3009 USDC transferWithAuthorization via Privy, retries with the X-PAYMENT header, and returns the resulting body. The agent must specify `max_amount_usdc` as a hard ceiling — requests demanding more are refused.

max_amount_usdc.description: Maximum USDC the agent may spend on this request, decimal string e.g. "0.10". Hard cap — refuse to pay anything more.

method.description: HTTP method for the resource fetch.

network.description: Monad network — "mainnet" or "testnet". Defaults to the server's configured network.

name: pay_for_service
title: Pay for an x402-protected service
